COMPCAT-015.note: Audit 2026-11-04 (Viktor, at 65e4394; started from Codex's uncommitted run): Shared JsonBoundary preflight (strict UTF-8 incl. surrogates, decoded duplicate keys, depth, bytes, lexical elements) fronts XANN, SXCU, SXIE Config.json/XSIE, editor preferences, application settings, PrivateJsonFile and the workflow, destination and journal readers. Tests: JsonBoundaryTest::adversarial and lexicalStringsAndBounds; XannCompatibilityTest::adversarialJsonIsRejected, boundedGzipRejectsTruncationTrailingMembersExpansionAndSize, lexicalElementBudgetIsEnforcedBeforeDocumentConstruction and pathTraversalAndCyclicReferencesReject; SxcuImportTest::boundaryMatrix and criticalMetadataCannotBeAccepted; SxiePresetTest::jsonBoundaryMatrix plus the existing bounded ZIP tests and path-traversal rows; SettingsCompatibilityTest::readerAdversarialMatrix, embeddedPathsAreRefusedWithoutOpeningThem and nativeStoreReadersShareTheLexicalBoundary. Rejections use stable value-free codes, no reader touches the network, and imported references are never followed ($ref is refused as unsafe data, so cycles cannot be dereferenced). The editor recent-image list is exempt from the '..' rule by design (absolute opened-file identities keep kernel meaning through symlinks and are never read when parsed). Native, physical and human qualification remain with the owner.

COMPCAT-016.note: Audit 2026-11-04 (Viktor, at 65e4394; started from Codex's uncommitted run): src/storage/COMPATIBILITY.md fixes the canonical rules: UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds and Z on write, '.' decimals, case-sensitive native IDs/enums with documented case-insensitive legacy aliases, portable basenames, LF output (CRLF input accepted) and NFC for display names and font families. Fixtures load identically under German/Arabic/Turkish locales, LF/CRLF and composed/decomposed Unicode (JsonBoundaryTest::localeAndNewlineVariants; XannCompatibilityTest::localesNewlinesAndUnicodeVariantsKeepTheSameMeaning; SettingsCompatibilityTest::localeNewlineAndFontNormalizationFixtures; SxcuImportTest::reportsAndCanonicalRoundTrip; SxiePresetTest::canonicalPresetLocaleNewlineAndUnicode); non-portable data is dispositioned by export omission codes (COMPCAT-006 tests). Decision (Mike's rule: follow the reference app): timezone-less legacy XANN timestamps keep local interpretation, as .NET does for an unspecified-kind DateTime, and are rewritten as UTC on the next save. Windows and macOS runtime fixtures are not run here; they and human qualification remain with the owner.
